architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-001 owns both SavingsAccount (ENT-065) and IsaSubscriptionRecord (ENT-066).
design_decisions.rationale: Both entities are integral to the savings and ISA product — they are not independently deployable sub-capabilities at current complexity.

consumed_events.name: SavingsAccountApplicationSubmitted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-026: Trigger AML monitoring setup for the new savings relationship. Check customer risk score for enhanced monitoring flag.
consumed_events.maps_to: Internal AML monitoring record — new account linked to customer KYC profile

consumed_events.name: SavingsAccountOpened
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-026: Establish transaction monitoring baseline for new savings account. Set AML threshold alerts.

consumed_events.name: SavingsAccountOpened
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-026: Record new savings account for FSCS reporting. Update HMRC ISA registry notification queue if is_isa_wrapper=true.
consumed_events.maps_to: Regulatory reporting dataset: FSCS eligible deposits count; HMRC ISA annual return queue

consumed_events.name: SavingsAccountOpened
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-026: Dispatch account opening confirmation to customer.
consumed_events.maps_to: Notification template: savings_account_opened (or cash_isa_opened if is_isa_wrapper=true)

consumed_events.name: SavingsAccountOpened
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-026: Write immutable audit record of account opening.

cross_service_interaction_summary.purpose: AML monitoring setup for new savings relationship
FSCS reporting and HMRC ISA notification queue
